platform: Windows, isolated production FastAPI and SQLite, offline model, subprocess crash injection

verified_contracts.T04: Reused evidence is re-checked where it is used: plan admission verifies the source attempt's acceptance receipt plus its captured Mandate expiry, policy revision, owner and session binding; the final delivery transaction repeats all of them and additionally requires a reused verification task to cover retained artifacts with unrevoked authorized read receipts. A verifier that claimed success without reading the current artifact keeps the goal at needs-verification or partial, never completed.
verified_contracts.T03: Peer citations are checked for sender and recipient at submission and re-validated per citation at actual delivery: version still current, publish action not erased, producer Mandate on-version, and both parties still authorized. After revocation, supersession or source erasure a queued message is delivered without the citation's name, id or hash.
verified_contracts.T06: Mailbox-triggered Worker turns carry the captured safe_resume kernel policy in their run route. A real process interruption during a follow-up turn resumes from the checkpoint: the settled write replays from its recorded receipt exactly once, no unknown actions appear, and the delivery commits once in the original session.
verified_contracts.T10: The campus assistant full-chain scenario runs Research, Coding, Verification and Documentation in parallel through the production Web entry with directed peer requests carrying citations, owner revision reusing accepted prior-version tasks, and one in-session delivery per goal version.

offline_runs.scope: Acceptance blockers: reuse authorization re-checks, verifier receipt coverage, recipient citation authorization, queued citation drop, mailbox-turn crash resume, restored artifact subscription and scoped revocation, plus delegation and kernel restart boundaries and the strict-type checklist guard
Final batch suite: production OWA entry points, receipt resume, campus assistant full chain, delegation recovery, kernel restart and type checklist guard

strict_typing.notes: v2_0063 added to docs/v/reference/TYPE_CHECKING.md; the checklist guard test asserts config, document and files stay in lockstep.

regressions_fixed: waiting_for_peer now counts a Worker's open non-blocking requests, so dependents and delivery wait until a peer exchange resolves instead of reading mid-flight results

the delivery reduction bounds a verifier's expected read receipts to artifacts published before its latest attempt ended, so later grants from downstream producers no longer invalidate finished verification
